_dataset.name: reasoning-math
_dataset.title: Arithmetic word problems
_dataset.description: Short multi-step arithmetic. Scored by comparing the last number in the answer.

prompt: A shop sells pencils at 3 for $1. How many pencils can you buy with $7? Answer with just the number.
Tom has 12 apples. He gives 5 to Anna and then buys 8 more. How many apples does Tom have now? Answer with just the number.
What is 17 multiplied by 23? Answer with just the number.
A train travels at 60 km per hour for 2.5 hours. How many kilometres does it travel? Answer with just the number.
A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its area in square centimetres? Answer with just the number.
What is 15% of 240? Answer with just the number.
Sara is twice as old as Ben. Ben is 9 years old. How old will Sara be in 4 years? Answer with just the number.
There are 4 boxes with 9 eggs in each box. 7 eggs break. How many unbroken eggs are left? Answer with just the number.
What is 1000 minus 357? Answer with just the number.
A pizza is cut into 8 slices. Three friends eat 2 slices each. How many slices are left? Answer with just the number.
